description: Look up EPA enforcement actions taken against public water systems under the Safe Drinking Water Act. Filter by PWSID (Public Water System Identifier) to get all enforcement history for a specific utility, or filter by enforcement action type code. Returns enforcement date, action type, and originator. Enforcement types include Formal Administrative Orders (EFG), Compliance Schedules, Referral to State, and Civil Penalties. Combine with sdwis.water.violations to understand the full compliance picture for a water system. Data source: EPA SDWIS Federal Reporting Services, US Gov public domain.

action_type.description: Enforcement action type code (e.g. EFG for Formal Enforcement Order, 3EF for Third Violation)

limit.description: Maximum number of enforcement actions to return (1–100, default 20)

pwsid.description: Public Water System Identifier (PWSID) to look up enforcement actions for a specific system (e.g. CA3310067)

name: sdwis.water.enforcement

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Lookup Water System Enforcement Actions
